# A Venue’s Vital Statistics

*Page PDF 12*

## **A Venue’s Vital Statistics**
In order to generate a random inn you must first decide what tier of venue it is. Then roll to determine the inn’s vital statistics, which will give you a notion of the size and competence of the staff, the available fare, and what rooms are available. 

**Key to Drinks:** A (Ale), DA (Dwarf Ale), SB (Small Beer), SA (Strong Ale), ES (Excellent Spirits), FW (Fine Wine), LW (Legendary Wine), RS (Rough Spirits), S (Spirits), W (Wine). 

**Key to Board:** CR (Common Room), FR (Fine Room), L (Large Room), R (Room) 

## **Brass Tier Venues**
|**d10**|**Staf**|**Drinks**|**Fare**|**Board**|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**1**|Landlord|Small Beer (Poor)|None|None|
|**2**|Landlord|Small Beer|None|None|
|**3**|Skeleton Staf|Ale (Poor)|Snacks (Poor)|None|
|**4**|<br>Skeleton Staf|Ale|Snacks|None|
|**5**|<br>Skeleton Staf|Ale|Snacks and roll again|CR (12) (Poor)|
|**6**|<br>Adequate Staf|Small Beer, Ale|Stew (Poor)|CR (12)|
|**7**|<br>Adequate Staf|Ale, Strong Ale|Stew|CR (18) (Poor)|
|**8**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, SA, RS|Stew and roll again|CR (18)|
|**9**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, RS, W|Simple Meal (Poor)|CR (12), R (2) (Poor)|
|**10**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, SA, RS, W|Simple Meal|CR (12), R (2)|

## **Silver Tier Venues**
|**d10**|**Staf**|**Drinks**|**Fare**|**Board**|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**1**|Skeleton Staf|Ale|Snacks|None|
|**2**|<br>Adequate Staf|Ale|Stew|CR (12)|
|**3**|<br>Adequate Staf|Ale, Strong Ale|Simple Meal (Poor)|CR (18)|
|**4**|<br>Adequate Staf|Ale, Strong Ale|Simple Meal and roll again|CR (12), R (2)|
|**5**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, SA, RS|Simple Meal|CR (12), R (6)|
|**6**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, SA, W|Meal (Poor)|CR (12), R (2), L (2)|
|**7**|<br>Adequate Staf|A, DA, SA, RS, W|Meal|CR (12), R (6), L (4)|
|**8**|<br>Quality Staf|A, SA, S, W|Meal and roll again|R (6), L (2)|
|**9**|<br>Quality Staf|A, SA, S, W|Menu|R (8), L (4)|
|**10**|<br>Quality Staf|A, DA, SA, S, W, FW|Menu|R (8), L (4), FR (2)|
